responsibility: Implements the main Renesas RX target backend in C++, owning the target hooks, ABI rules, addressing and small-data/PID handling, builtin expansion, function calling and return conventions, prologue/epilogue generation, assembler printing, section selection, cost modeling, register usage, and assorted RTL helpers and peephole support. This is the operational core of the RX port that connects GCC middle-end decisions to RX-specific RTL validation, lowering, diagnostics, and final assembly emission.
same_name_distinction: Defines the executable C++ side of the RX port: the target hook functions, option override logic, builtin expansion, address legalization, and final targetm initializer that implement behavior declared by rx.h, cooperate with patterns in rx.md, and consume options generated from rx.opt.
